name: Stereo Viewer
description: Both clips shrink into rounded cards: the first splits apart and swings away, then the second swings in, like pressing the lever of a stereo viewer toy. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: zoom
params.description: Size of the cards relative to the frame

params.name: corner_radius
params.description: Corner radius of the cards, as a fraction of the frame height

params.name: back_color
params.description: Color around the cards (`#00000000` leaves it transparent, as in the original)
